body:
CPP Investments and Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan have agreed to acquire stakes in Cary Group alongside a fresh investment from Nordic Capital, creating a consortium to support the vehicle glass repair and replacement provider’s continued international expansion.

The three investors will each hold approximately equal stakes and share control of the business. Ontario Teachers’ and CPP Investments are expected to invest €545m and €500m, respectively. Nordic Capital will realise its existing investment and reinvest alongside the Canadian pension groups, while CVC Capital Partners XIII, a co-owner since 2022, will exit its holding.

Nordic Capital first invested in Cary Group in 2018, helping expand the company from a Swedish business with just over 100 workshops into a platform spanning 13 European countries. Headquartered in Stockholm, Cary now operates approximately 1,800 workshops and employs 4,500 people. It generated SEK9bn in net revenue in the 12 months to October 2026 and handled approximately 1.4 million vehicle glass jobs.

The consortium members said they intend to work with Cary’s management to pursue organic growth and strategic acquisitions, strengthen the company’s position in existing markets, and invest in operational improvements and digitalisation. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals and is expected to complete in H1 2027.
